battleFormations.name: Awakened Dynasty
battleFormations.effect: Command Protocols: While a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading a unit, add 1 to Hit rolls made for that unit.

battleFormations.name: Canoptek Court
battleFormations.effect: Power Matrix: Your deployment zone is always within the Power Matrix; you contest No Man's Land/enemy deployment zone via objective control. CRYPTEK/CANOPTEK units re-roll Hit rolls of 1 (full re-roll if wholly within the Power Matrix).

battleFormations.name: Obeisance Phalanx
battleFormations.effect: Worthy Foes: Select an enemy unit each Command phase; NOBLE/LYCHGUARD/TRIARCH attacks against it gain +1 to the Wound roll.

battleFormations.name: Annihilation Legion
battleFormations.effect: Annihilation Protocol: DESTROYER CULT and FLAYED ONES units re-roll Charge rolls (+1 vs below-half-strength targets); DESTROYER CULT ranged attacks against the closest target gain +1 AP.

artefacts.effect: [NECRONS only] The bearer's led unit gains the Stealth ability.
